feat.name: Adaptable Fading
entries: You can easily overthrow an enemy's fortitude. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

When you make an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} using your Strength, you can choose to add half your Constitution modifier to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}. Alternatively, when you would make an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} using Constitution, you can add half your Strength modifier to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses of this feature when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

When an effect you control would call for a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can instead have it call for a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. Alternatively, when an effect you control would call for a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can instead have it call for a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses of this feature when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

feat.name: Auditory Dampening
entries: You've developed resilience against debilitating noises, gaining the following benefits:

items: Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

While you are {@condition Deafened|sw5e-phb|deafened}, you can make {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} that rely on hearing with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}, instead of automatically failing them.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid sonic damage.

feat.name: Blinding Agility
entries: You have the reflexes one who can see things before they happen, granting the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. If you are already proficient in them, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in them.
Weapons that lack the two-handed or special properties are considered to have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property} for you.
Opportunity attacks made against you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

feat.name: Casting Specialist
entries: Choose one from force- or tech-casting. You've mastered your chosen casting type, gaining the following benefits:

items: You gain a +1 bonus to your force or tech save DC and your force or tech attack modifier.

Once per turn, when you cast a power that requires an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or you can force one creature affected by the power to have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} or {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (your choice). Once you've used this feature on a power, you can't affect that power again until you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Once you've used this feature on a creature, you can't do so again until you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

Once per turn, when you cast a power that doesn't require an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, but requires a die roll, you can choose the maximum or minimum on the die (your choice). If the power requires rolling multiple dice, you can only affect a number of them equal to half your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} (rounded up) in this way. Once you've used this feature on a power, you can't affect that power again until you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries: You can select this feat twice. Each time you do so, you must choose a different casting type.

feat.name: Chemical Buffer
entries: You're able to neutralize caustic chemicals, mitigating their worst effects. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Dexterity, Constitution, or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You cannot be disintegrated, and you ignore the first {@condition Corroded|sw5e-phb|corroded} level you receive.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid acid damage.

feat.name: Class Improvement
entries: You adopt a particular new application to your class, gaining the following benefits:

items: Increase an ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Choose one of the class improvement options, detailed later in this chapter.

entries: You can take this feat multiple times.

feat.name: Close Quarters Caster
entries: You've {@feat Practiced|sw5e-phb|practiced} utilizing powers in close quarters, learning techniques that grant you the following benefits:

items: When making a ranged force or tech attack while you are within 5 feet of a hostile creature, you do not have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}.
Your ranged force and tech attacks ignore {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|half cover} and three-quarters {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} against targets within 30 feet of you.

You learn one at-will power that requires an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}. Your casting ability for this at-will power depends on the power list you chose from: Wisdom or Charisma (depending on power alignment) for {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} or Intelligence for {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

feat.name: Combat Caster
entries: You've {@feat Practiced|sw5e-phb|practiced} making your powers more difficult to avoid, learning techniques that grant you the following benefits:

items: When a creature rolls a 1 on the {@dice d20} roll of a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against a power you cast that deals damage, they instead take the highest number possible for the damage die.

You learn one at-will power that requires a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. Your casting ability for this at-will power depends on the power list you chose from: Wisdom or Charisma (depending on power alignment) for {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} or Intelligence for {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

feat.name: Companion Keeper
entries: You gain the services of a companion. Choose one of the companion nature options, detailed later in this chapter.

feat.name: Cunning Forcecaster
entries: You've discovered a clever avenue to your study of the Force. Choose one from Wisdom or Charisma. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can use Intelligence instead of the chosen ability as your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability}.
You can add Intelligence instead of the chosen ability when determining your maximum force points.

feat.name: Cunning Intellect
entries: You have the cunning of the most prolific scholars, granting the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. If you are already proficient in them, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in them.

When you engage in the Training downtime activity, during resolution, you add your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} to the check. If you would already add your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, you instead add twice your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. If you would already add twice your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, you instead have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the check.

Whenever you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} that uses your Intelligence, you can add half your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} (rounded down) if it doesn't already include your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. Additionally, if you roll lower than half your level (rounded down) on an Intelligence check, you can instead use your level for the {@dice d20} roll.

feat.name: Double-Weapon Casting
entries: You've learned to blend your prowess with twinblades with your casting. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

When you use your action to Cast a Power that calls for a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} and attack with a weapon with the light and double properties while wielding it in two hands, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to engage in Double-Weapon Fighting. All the rules of Double-Weapon Fighting still apply to you.

feat.name: Dual Focused Caster
entries: You have learned to bifurcate your attention while concentrating on powers, learning techniques that grant you the following benefits:

items: If you attempt to cast a power that requires {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} while already concentrating on an existing power, you can maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on both powers simultaneously. You must spend your action each subsequent round on maintaining this {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration}, or lose {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} for both powers.

At the end of each of your turns where you have two powers you are concentrating on, you must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC equals 10 + the number of complete rounds you've been concentrating on two powers). On a failure, you lose {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} for both powers. You can drop {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on one of your powers during your turn as a free action to avoid this {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

Any time you would be forced to make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} due to taking damage, the DC equals 10 + both powers' levels combined, or half the damage you take, whichever number is higher. On a failure, you lose {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on both powers.

feat.name: Dutifully Deployed
entries: You've developed an aptitude for a particular deployment on a starship. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase an ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain 1 rank in a deployment of your choice. This rank does not count towards or affect your prestige.
The maximum number of ranks you can gain in deployments increases by 1. You can still only gain 5 ranks in a deployment.

feat.name: Electrical Grounding
entries: You're able to avoid the brunt of electric shocks. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

At the start of each of your turns while {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked}, you can choose to have a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}, or you can choose to be able to take both an action and a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on your turn.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid lightning damage.

feat.name: Exalted Awareness
entries: You have the wisdom associated with the most renowned masters of the Force, granting the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. If you are already proficient in them, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in them.
Creatures within 60 feet of you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}) checks made to hide from you.

As an action, you can sense the presence of illusions and other effects designed to {@optfeature Deceive|sw5e-phb|deceive} the senses within 30 feet of you, provided that you aren't {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded} or {@condition Deafened|sw5e-phb|deafened}. You sense that an effect is trying to trick you, but you gain no insight into what is hidden or its true nature. Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

feat.name: Exotic Weapon Training
entries: Mastery of simple and {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} has unlocked new potential for you. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency in three exotic weapons. You must have proficiency in all simple and {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} in the exotic weapon's category to gain proficiency in it. If the exotic has modes that would fall in two different weapon categories, you require proficiency all simple and {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} in both categories in order to gain proficiency in that exotic.

feat.name: Flexible Rending
entries: You are adept at overwhelming an opponent's reflexes. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Dexterity or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

When you make an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} using your Dexterity, you can choose to add half your Intelligence modifier to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}. Alternatively, when you would make an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} using Intelligence, you can add half your Dexterity modifier to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses of this feature when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

When an effect you control would call for a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can instead have it call for a Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. Alternatively, when an effect you control would call for a Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can instead have it call for a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses of this feature when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

feat.name: Force Frustrater
entries: You've {@feat Practiced|sw5e-phb|practiced} techniques to resist being manipulated by the Force. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Strength, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When a creature attempts to move you against your will using a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, the maximum distance it can move you is halved.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid force damage.

feat.name: Greater Force-Sensitive
entries: You know one at-will {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. Additionally, you know one 4th-level {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, which you can cast once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} is Wisdom or Charisma (depending on power alignment).

feat.name: Greater Tech Dabbler
entries: You know one at-will {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. Additionally, you know one 4th-level {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, which you can cast once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} is Intelligence. You require use of a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} for these powers.

feat.name: Heat Shielded
entries: You can tolerate extremely hot temperatures. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Dexterity, Consitution, or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} due to extreme heat, and you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to end the {@condition Ignited|sw5e-phb|ignited} condition on yourself, instead of your action.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid fire damage.

feat.name: Improved Force-Sensitive
entries: You know one at-will {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. Additionally, you know one 3rd-level {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, which you can cast once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} is Wisdom or Charisma (depending on power alignment).

feat.name: Improved Tech Dabbler
entries: You know one at-will {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. Additionally, you know one 3rd-level {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, which you can cast once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} is Intelligence. You require use of a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} for these powers.

feat.name: Master Force-Sensitive
entries: You know one at-will {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. Additionally, you know one 5th-level {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, which you can cast once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} is Wisdom or Charisma (depending on power alignment).

feat.name: Master Tech Dabbler
entries: You know one at-will {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. Additionally, you know one 5th-level {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, which you can cast once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} is Intelligence. You require use of a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} for these powers.

feat.name: Metabolic Tolerance
entries: You've developed resilience against many poisons, gaining the following benefits:

items: Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
As an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can expend a Hit Die to end the {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} condition on yourself.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid poison damage.

feat.name: Mindful Meditator
entries: You've learned meditation techniques to calm your mind. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You only need 3 hours of sleep during a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} to gain its benefits, instead of 6. Additionally, if your {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} would be interrupted, you only need to complete the {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} instead of restarting it to gain its benefits.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid psychic damage.

feat.name: Mounted Caster
entries: You are trained in the use of powers while mounted. While you are mounted and aren't {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated}, you gain the following benefits:

items: When you cast a power targeting yourself, you can also affect your mount with the power.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on melee force or tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against any unmounted creature that is smaller than your mount.

If your mount is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and only half damage if it fails.

feat.name: Multiclass Improvement
entries: You've learned to blend the skills of your different classes. Choose two of the multiclass improvement options, detailed later in this chapter. You can take this feat multiple times.

feat.name: Overwhelming Presence
entries: You have the presence of the most affluent of leaders, granting the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. If you are already proficient in them, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in them.

While you are conscious, up to five friendly creatures within 30 feet of you who can see or hear you and who can understand you can gain a bonus to one Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} they make equal to your Charisma modifier. Once they've done so, they can't do so again until they finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

As an action, you can attempt to distract up to five creatures you can see within 30 feet of you. Each creature must make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Charisma modifier). Any creature immune to being {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} is unaffected. If you or your companions are fighting a creature, it has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, for the next minute, a creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks made to perceive any creature other than you until the effect ends or until the target can no longer see or hear you. This ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die.

feat.name: Quick Caster
entries: You've {@feat Practiced|sw5e-phb|practiced} casting powers in quick succession, learning techniques that grant you the following benefits:

items: When you cast a power with a casting time of a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you may use your action to cast a power with a power level no higher than half your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} (rounded down).

When you cast a power with a casting time of a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can cast it without expending force or tech points as long as it is no higher level than your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

feat.name: Sniping Caster
entries: You've {@feat Practiced|sw5e-phb|practiced} casting powers more accurately from long range, learning techniques that give you the following benefits:

items: When you cast a power that requires you to make an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, the power's range is doubled.
Your ranged force and tech attacks ignore one-quarter, half, and three-quarters {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}.

You learn one at-will power that requires an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}. Your casting ability for this at-will power depends on the power list you chose from: Wisdom or Charisma (depending on power alignment) for {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} or Intelligence for {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

feat.name: Spiritual Techcaster
entries: You've developed a transcendent approach to your tech prowess. Choose one from Wisdom or Charisma. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase the chosen ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can use the chosen ability instead of Intelligence as your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability}.
You can add the chosen ability instead of Intelligence when determining your maximum tech points.

feat.name: Splashclass Improvement
entries: You've learned to blend the skills of your different classes. Choose one of the splashclass improvement options, detailed later in this chapter. You can take this feat multiple times.

feat.name: Titan's Power
entries: You have the strength that legends tell of, granting the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. If you are already proficient in them, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in them.
You ignore the two-handed property of weapons with which you are proficient.
When you miss with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, the creature takes damage equal to your Strength modifier. This damage is of the same type as the weapon's damage.

feat.name: Total Reconstruction
entries: You are more machine than man. While repaired in a similar configuration as your own species, you are subject to the following changes:

items: Increase an ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Choose one class of droid (class I-V or tracker). You count as the chosen creature type in addition to your other type.
You are resistant to necrotic and poison damage, and are immune to poison and disease.
You do not need to eat or drink. Additionally, you no longer require a tech focus to cast {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

You are vulnerable to ion damage. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against effects that would deal ion or lightning damage.
You can not sense the Force, use {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, or take levels in {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} classes.
You are no longer a valid target for cybernetic augmentations or genetic mutations. However, you are now a valid target for droid customizations.

feat.name: Two-Weapon Casting
entries: You've learned to better combine your dual wielding with your powers. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

When you use your action to Cast a Power that calls for a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} and attack with a light weapon that you're holding in one hand, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to engage in Two-Weapon Fighting. All the rules of Two-Weapon Fighting still apply to you.

feat.name: Unnatural Resilience
entries: You have the fortitude often attributed to gods, granting the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. If you are already proficient in them, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in them.

Enhanced effects, such as powers or medpacs, that would restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to you can't restore an amount less than half your level + your Constitution modifier. If this amount would exceed that maximum amount of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} that effect could restore, you instead take that effect's maximum.
You can add your Constitution modifier to {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|death saving throws} you make.

feat.name: Versatile Withering
entries: You have learned to easily overcome an adversary's will. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

When you make an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} using your Wisdom, you can choose to add half your Charisma modifier to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}. Alternatively, when you would make an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} using Charisma, you can add half your Wisdom modifier to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses of this feature when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

When an effect you control would call for a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can instead have it call for a Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. Alternatively, when an effect you control would call for a Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can instead have it call for a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses of this feature when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

feat.name: Vigorous Virility
entries: Thanks to the strength of your vitality, you gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
As an action, you can expend a Hit Die to end the {@condition Weakened|sw5e-phb|weakened} condition on yourself.

Once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, when you complete a {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest}, you can expend a Hit Die to remove 1 level of {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion}.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid necrotic damage.

feat.name: War Caster
entries: You've {@feat Practiced|sw5e-phb|practiced} casting powers in the midst of combat, learning techniques that grant you the following benefits:

items: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} that you make to maintain your {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on a power when you take damage.

Once per round, when a hostile creature provokes an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack} from you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to cast a power at the creature, rather than making an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack}. The power must have a casting time of 1 action and must target only that creature.

feat.name: Well-Insulated
entries: You can tolerate extremely cold temperatures. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Dexterity, Constitution, or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} due to extreme cold, and each {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level only reduces your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} by 5 feet, unless it would reduce your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} to 0.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid cold damage.
